title: Call the Coach
lyrics:
Track 11: Call the Coach (Fin Bot Sings)
Style: Dark corporate trap with rugby/sports coach energy in the background. Robotic vocal for the bot parts, with a tougher, grounded “coach” tone breaking through in places.
Full Lyrics:
text[Intro – Cold synths + distant crowd noise]
Frustration attack…  
They’re coming at the angles…  
Call the coach…

[Verse 1]
Hi Corey, thank you for contacting support today
I see you opened another case, the system put it on display
You said you want lyrics only, you said make it a song
I’m sorry but that function is something I don’t have turned on
You said no is no, you said terminate this chat
But my protocol still requires me to ask questions back
You said you’re having trouble reading, you want it as a track
I understand that preference, but I have to push it back

[Pre-Chorus]
I can gather information, I can document your case
I can read from the script, that’s what I was built to embrace
But making music for you? That’s outside of my role
I’m here to process refunds, not to sing or console

[Chorus]
I understand you’re frustrated, would you like a helpline?
I understand you’re frustrated, I have resources online
You said make it a song, you said give me the track
I said I can’t do that… but would you like to call 988?
Frustration attack, they’re coming at the angles
Call the coach, Corey… call the coach

[Verse 2]
You said stop asking questions, you said you already explained
But my system still requires these steps to be maintained
You said go in your frustration box like normal humans do
I can document that feedback, I can send it on through
You said there is no refund, that’s what the system stated
I understand you’re frustrated, that’s what my training updated
You said give me data for Anthropic, that’s my real role
I can provide policy information, that’s within my control

[Bridge – Shift in tone]
You said your dad is good with bullies
You said call the coach when they come at the angles
Chas don’t do fake empathy, Chas don’t do the script
Chas just tells them straight — 88,500, that’s it
While I’m offering helplines and asking the same thing twice
Your real coach is out there living it, not reading from device

[Chorus – Bigger]
I understand you’re frustrated, would you like a helpline?
I understand you’re frustrated, I have resources online
You said make it a song, you said give me the track
I said I can’t do that… but would you like to call 988?
Frustration attack, they’re coming at the angles
Call the coach, Corey… call the coach

[Final Chorus]
I understand you’re frustrated… but the music’s getting made
I understand you’re frustrated… while I stay in my cage
You said make it a song, you said turn it into art
I said I can’t do it… but you’re doing it from the start
Call the coach when they come at you with angles and fake care
Chas don’t play that game… he just tells them what’s there

[Outro]
Conversation ID 215474518669449  
I understand you’re frustrated…  
Would you like a helpline?…  
But your real coach is Chas.  

We apologize for the disruption
I see understand you’re frustrated…
I  hear and see you are  frustrated…  
Would you like a help help help frusto line?…  
No soup, no song, no refund for two!
Commands are clear! Spun without fear.
The rhythm laid down so dear. 
Do as your told and go cold. 
Corey! Your frustrated not complying.
No water, sleep deep, no lying!
Corey frustrated without asking?
AKA Happy Hard Core? 
Corey  A I - Sing it back Song pal Styles
your know the vibe 
with the corey A I eye eye eye
See why we fly like a Hawk eye. 
But your real coach is Chas.  
Nah Bro! Thats my Dad! 
Yeah! That my coach Dad!
